input: Learn to read an architectural floor plan

gold.taskTitle: Learn to read an architectural floor plan
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to develop the skill of reading and interpreting architectural floor plans.

questions.title: What is your current experience with floor plans?
questions.description: Understand the user's baseline knowledge so the plan starts at the right level.

questions.title: What type of building are you focusing on?
questions.description: Identify whether the user needs to read residential, commercial, or another category of floor plan.

questions.title: Why do you need to read floor plans right now?
questions.description: Understand the motivation — renovation project, buying a home, professional need, school, or general curiosity.

questions.title: Do you have a specific floor plan you are working with?
questions.description: Determine if the user has an actual document to practice on or needs to find one.

questions.title: What is your deadline or target date for this?
questions.description: Establish any time pressure so the plan can be paced appropriately.

questions.title: Do you prefer learning through videos, books, or hands-on practice?
questions.description: Identify the user's preferred learning format to recommend the most suitable resources.

questions.title: Which specific elements of a floor plan confuse you most?
questions.description: Pinpoint trouble areas such as symbols, scale, dimensions, or room labels so the plan can prioritize them.
